text_block_list.text:
After our outing, we arrived at Bubbly Land.
It was an inspection to offer advice to an entrepreneur
planning to build a leisure facility for young people.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaay!!
Going to the pool with Milady is pure hype~♪
choice_data_list: Did you ask Helios to help with the inspection?
Did you ask Helios to help with the inspection?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No. I have no recollection of calling for you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, you were asking for people on Umastagram, weren't you?
Like, 'Ayy, come join☆'!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It is true that I gave instructions to place an advertisement on Umastagram,
but my butler informed me that there was no reply.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But Mr. Butler and I are mutuals, right?
If he calls, of course I'm there in two seconds flat!♪

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...The utility of observing reactions up close
was proven at the amusement park last time."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation.
I look forward to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
K!
For now let's change and hit the water slide!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaay!!
(SPLAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whew!! Awesome!!
This feels sooo gooood☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, sorry!!
Did you get splashed?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? When did you get an umbrella!?
Not even a single drop on you! As expected of the young lady~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful for your kind words.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Experiencing the attraction for yourself seems to have deepened your immersion.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't it way more hyped over there?
Let's go check it out, Milady! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaay!! Hype hype hypeee☆
Shout out to my girl with the fierce heart, Milady, heyyy!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Helios-san seems to be
rather excited today.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey milady, dance with me!
Let's get our vibes up together♪

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No. It's hard to take in the whole picture from here,
so I'll step back and observe.

With smooth, deft footwork, Daiichi Ruby slipped gracefully
through the people and made her way out of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? For real? That dance just now!?
Wasn't it insanely sick~!?
choice_data_list: I don't think it was dancing, though...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Your footwork was seriously godlike!
I can't even! My heart won't stop throbbing~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aah, that was the absolute best~♪
Being with the young lady was super crazy thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, jeez, this is so fun I'm reaching max capacity!
Thanks a ton, Ojou.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...?
I haven't done anything special, though.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"No way, tons of stuff happened!
Like the umbrella guard!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She was so cool, just like a samurai~!
I fell in love with her all over again☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And the tap dance got the crowd super hyped too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My heart was pounding so fast! Felt like
someone was dancing right on top of it~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I got to see a side of the young lady I've never seen before,
so it's suuuper awesome♪
choice_data_list: Everyone has their own way of enjoying things, I suppose.
Everyone has their own way of enjoying things, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I would like to hear
more of your feedback regarding our facilities.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nyaha~, so salty!
Total rich girl vibes though, love it!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I would appreciate it if you could give
a slightly more concrete impression.
choice_data_list: In the end, isn't it who you go with that matters?
I think these impressions are important too.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? Thank you for the advice.
I have obtained valuable data once again.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I sincerely appreciate all the hard work from both of you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heheh♪ Let's go on another date sometime, m'lady☆

I was worried about how she interacted with others,
but I was deeply moved to see that this unwavering stance
was precisely what made Daiichi Ruby who she is.

I told her that what was said just now
was Daitaku Helios's honest thoughts and opinions.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I see. In that case, allow me
to analyze the true meaning behind those words.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: With that in mind, could you please share your impressions of this leisure facility once more?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Okey-doke♪ Um, let's see, uhhh...
Today was god-tier and totally the best!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you so very much for your invaluable feedback.
Please let us know if there is anything else we can assist you with.”

For better or worse,
Daiichi Ruby never wavers in the slightest,
leaving me deeply moved.
